brand.name: Eco Saathi
brand.hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM – 7:30 PM IST

returns_policy.hygiene_exceptions: Oral care products (toothbrushes, tongue cleaners) and personal care items cannot be returned once package seal is broken unless received damaged.
returns_policy.process: Submit return request from My Account with photo proof within 7 days. Return courier pickup is arranged free of charge. Refund is processed within 48 hours of return receipt to original payment method, or bank account for COD orders.
returns_policy.cancellation: Orders can be cancelled free of charge prior to dispatch from warehouse.

materials_and_care.benefits: Fast-growing grass, anti-bacterial, completely biodegradable, water-resistant
materials_and_care.care: Keep in a dry, well-ventilated stand. Avoid keeping bristles submerged in water cups. Compost the handle when discarding.

materials_and_care.origin: Wild harvested by women artisans of Mayurbhanj, Odisha
materials_and_care.benefits: Natural high tensile strength, eco-friendly dye colors, long-lasting durability, empowers tribal women SHGs
materials_and_care.care: Dust with dry soft cloth. Wipe stains with slightly damp sponge and dry immediately in shaded sun. Do not soak.

materials_and_care.origin: Pruned seasoned medicinal Neem (Azadirachta indica) wood
materials_and_care.benefits: Naturally anti-fungal, anti-microbial, anti-dandruff for combs, gentle on gums and hair
materials_and_care.care: Wash with mild soap and dry immediately. Rub a few drops of coconut or mustard oil once a month to retain luster.

materials_and_care.origin: Natural golden fiber from coastal Odisha and Eastern India
materials_and_care.benefits: Heavy-duty load bearing, 100% biodegradable, zero carbon footprint
materials_and_care.care: Spot clean with damp cloth. Air dry. Do not machine wash or bleach.

materials_and_care.origin: Upcycled coconut farming by-products and natural plant fibers
materials_and_care.benefits: Zero waste, upcycled, free from synthetic polymers and petrochemicals
materials_and_care.care: Rinse loofahs thoroughly and hang to dry. Candles: trim wick to 1/4 inch before burning.

customizations: Laser engraving of company logo on bamboo

frequently_asked_questions.question: How do I know if you deliver to my pincode?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: We deliver across 19,000+ pincodes across India! You can enter your 6-digit pincode on any product page or in cart to see exact delivery timelines and Cash on Delivery eligibility.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Are your products 100% plastic-free?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes! All Eco Saathi products are crafted from bamboo, sabai grass, jute, neem wood and organic materials. Our packaging is also 100% plastic-free using kraft paper, paper tape, and corrugated cardboard boxes.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Where are your products made?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Our products are lovingly handcrafted by over 120 artisan families and women self-help groups across Odisha, notably in Mayurbhanj, Khordha, and coastal districts.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How does the AI assistant recommend products?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Saathi AI recommends products directly from our live catalog based on your specific need, recipient, material preference, or budget. It never invents fake prices or out-of-stock items.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Can I get an order invoice with my company's GST number?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes! Enter your company name and GSTIN during checkout or in the Corporate Gifting portal, and a tax-compliant GST invoice will be automatically generated upon order confirmation.
